name: KOTA-style knockout with a second chance (heats of 3, second-chance round, 1 v 1 heats, final of 3)
description: Round 1 heats of 3: winners go straight to Round 3, 2nd and 3rd are reseeded into the second-chance round (heats of 2). Second-chance winners join Round 3; the others share 13th (or the equivalent for the field size). From Round 3: 1 v 1 heats, knockout, to a 3-rider final. Every rider rides at least 2 heats. Optional flag-out in Round 1 at minute 8 (lowest-scoring rider out; others continue). Based on the Red Bull King of the Air 2026 published format (18 riders); the generator scales to other field sizes.
basedOn: Red Bull King of the Air 2026 format (redbull.com)
